description: HOOVER HERITAGE: For over 100 years, Hoover has designed powerful, easy-to-use appliances that clean your home from floor to ceiling. We combine cutting-edge technology with a legacy of reliability to enhance your daily life. 360° AQUA SPINSCRUB TECHNOLOGY: Counter-rotating XL brushes dig deep into carpet fibers to lift embedded dirt, tough stains, and allergens from all angles. AUTOMIX SOLUTION SYSTEM: Takes the guesswork out of cleaning by automatically mixing and dispensing the exact amount of solution and water for optimal results. MOTION SENSE WASH & DRY: Seamlessly transitions between modes. Simply push forward to wash the carpet and pull backward to activate powerful drying extraction. QUICK DRYING CAPABILITY: Engineered with advanced heat technology to extract heavy moisture, leaving your carpets dry and ready to walk on in less than 45 minutes. DEEP CLEANING FOR PETS: Effectively targets and neutralizes stubborn pet odors, muddy paw prints, and severe stains in high-traffic areas of your home. ANTIMICROBIAL WASH TOOL: Includes a specialized handheld tool treated with antimicrobial materials to prevent the growth of odor-causing bacteria and fungi. EASY-FILL & EMPTY TANKS: Features high-capacity, dual-tank technology that keeps clean (2.9L) and dirty water(3.5L) completely separate for a more hygienic clean. WHOLE HOME REACH: Comes with a long 2.5m stretch hose and versatile attachments to clean stairs, upholstery, and hard-to-reach corners effortlessly. COMPREHENSIVE CUSTOMER SUPPORT: With over 90+ dedicated offices across India, Hoover provides door-step service for all users. We offer free installation and home service, ensuring customer needs are prioritized. Simply reach out via our toll-free number for assistance with demonstrations, installations, and any service requirements.
